name: Kirinuki Studio
description: Kirinuki Studio is a calm block theme for commercial product photography studios that shoot catalogue and online-shop images in batches. The home page opens on a grained stone mist with the headline at the left and three product photographs fused into one chamfered polygon at the right, then a pale statement sheet, a near-black band of chamfered work tiles that settle from a tilt, a grid-ruled sheet of outline chips for the kinds of shoot, the day rate, a shoot day and the one way to book. Schibsted Grotesk and Albert Sans, high-key photography, quiet scroll effects.
